datasets.name: ds_queue_kpis
queryLines: SELECT MEASURE(`Total Votes`) AS vote_count, MEASURE(`skips`) AS skip_count, MEASURE(`skip_rate`) AS skip_share, MEASURE(`Unique Reviewers`) AS reviewer_count
WHERE (vote_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max OR :date_range IS NULL)

datasets.name: ds_votes_skips_daily
datasets.displayName: Queue: Votes vs Skips per Day
queryLines: SELECT vote_date, campaign_id, MEASURE(`Total Votes`) AS vote_count, MEASURE(`skips`) AS skip_count
WHERE (vote_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max OR :date_range IS NULL)

datasets.name: ds_skips_by_campaign
datasets.displayName: Queue: Skip Rate and Reviewers by Campaign
queryLines: SELECT campaign_id, MEASURE(`Total Votes`) AS vote_count, MEASURE(`skips`) AS skip_count, MEASURE(`skip_rate`) AS skip_share, MEASURE(`Unique Reviewers`) AS active_reviewers
AND (vote_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max OR :date_range IS NULL)

datasets.name: ds_top_skipped_assets
queryLines: SELECT asset_id, MEASURE(`skips`) AS skip_count, MEASURE(`Total Votes`) AS vote_count, MEASURE(`skip_rate`) AS skip_share
WHERE (vote_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max OR :date_range IS NULL)

datasets.name: ds_skip_reasons
queryLines: SELECT skip_reason, campaign_id, MEASURE(`skips`) AS skip_count
AND (vote_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max OR :date_range IS NULL)

datasets.name: ds_queue_by_asset_type
datasets.displayName: Queue: Assets by Type and Review Status
queryLines: SELECT asset_type, status, MEASURE(`Total Assets`) AS asset_count, MEASURE(`Reviewed Assets`) AS reviewed_count

datasets.name: ds_reviewer_skips
queryLines: SELECT email, MEASURE(`Total Votes`) AS vote_total, MEASURE(`total_skips`) AS skip_total

datasets.name: ds_campaign_kpis
queryLines: SELECT MEASURE(`Campaign Count`) AS active_campaigns, MEASURE(`Avg Completion`) AS avg_completion, MEASURE(`Total Assets`) AS assigned_assets, MEASURE(`Reviewed Assets`) AS reviewed_assets

datasets.name: ds_active_campaign_progress
queryLines: SELECT campaign_type, scope_domain, completion_rule, MEASURE(`Campaign Count`) AS campaigns, MEASURE(`Total Assets`) AS assigned_assets, MEASURE(`Reviewed Assets`) AS reviewed_assets, MEASURE(`Avg Completion`) AS avg_completion

datasets.name: ds_campaign_status_mix
queryLines: SELECT campaign_status, campaign_type, MEASURE(`Campaign Count`) AS campaigns

datasets.name: ds_feedback_kpis
queryLines: SELECT MEASURE(`Total Batches`) AS batches, MEASURE(`Success Rate`) AS success_rate, MEASURE(`Failed Batches`) AS failed_batches, MEASURE(`Avg Processing Time`) AS avg_processing_s, MEASURE(`Total Assets Processed`) AS assets_processed
WHERE (batch_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max OR :date_range IS NULL)

datasets.name: ds_feedback_by_status
datasets.displayName: Feedback: Batches by Status per Day
queryLines: SELECT batch_date, status, MEASURE(`Total Batches`) AS batches, MEASURE(`Total Assets Processed`) AS assets_processed
WHERE (batch_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max OR :date_range IS NULL)

datasets.name: ds_feedback_backlog
datasets.displayName: Feedback: Edit Votes vs Pending Batches
queryLines: SELECT MEASURE(`Edit Count`) AS edit_votes FROM mv_review_activity WHERE (vote_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max OR :date_range IS NULL)
SELECT MEASURE(`Total Batches`) AS pending_batches, MEASURE(`Total Assets Processed`) AS pending_assets FROM mv_feedback_pipeline WHERE status = 'pending'
SELECT edits.edit_votes, pending.pending_batches, pending.pending_assets FROM edits CROSS JOIN pending

datasets.name: ds_feedback_latest
queryLines: SELECT batch_date, status, triggered_by, MEASURE(`Total Batches`) AS batches, MEASURE(`Total Assets Processed`) AS assets_processed, MEASURE(`Avg Processing Time`) AS avg_processing_s

datasets.name: ds_app_health_windows
datasets.displayName: App Health: Last 24 h vs 7 d
queryLines: WITH e24 AS (SELECT MEASURE(`Error Rate`) AS error_rate, MEASURE(`Error Count`) AS error_count FROM mv_otel_error_rate WHERE log_hour >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 24 HOURS),
e7 AS (SELECT MEASURE(`Error Rate`) AS error_rate, MEASURE(`Error Count`) AS error_count FROM mv_otel_error_rate WHERE log_hour >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS),

l24 AS (SELECT MEASURE(`P50 Latency`) AS p50_ms, MEASURE(`P95 Latency`) AS p95_ms, MEASURE(`Request Count`) AS requests FROM mv_otel_request_latency WHERE span_hour >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 24 HOURS),

l7 AS (SELECT MEASURE(`P50 Latency`) AS p50_ms, MEASURE(`P95 Latency`) AS p95_ms, MEASURE(`Request Count`) AS requests FROM mv_otel_request_latency WHERE span_hour >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS)
SELECT 1 AS sort_key, 'Last 24 h' AS time_window, e24.error_rate, e24.error_count, l24.p50_ms, l24.p95_ms, l24.requests FROM e24 CROSS JOIN l24
SELECT 2 AS sort_key, 'Last 7 d' AS time_window, e7.error_rate, e7.error_count, l7.p50_ms, l7.p95_ms, l7.requests FROM e7 CROSS JOIN l7

datasets.name: ds_errors_hourly
datasets.displayName: App Health: Error Rate per Hour (7 d)
queryLines: SELECT log_hour, MEASURE(`Error Rate`) AS error_rate, MEASURE(`Error Count`) AS error_count

datasets.name: ds_latency_hourly
datasets.displayName: App Health: Latency per Hour (7 d)
queryLines: SELECT span_hour, MEASURE(`P50 Latency`) AS p50_ms, MEASURE(`P95 Latency`) AS p95_ms, MEASURE(`Request Count`) AS requests
